title: Madhyamaheshwar Trek
reportingPoint: Departure is in the evening from Delhi; the overnight journey starts between 8 PM and 9 PM. The exact pickup point and time are shared once your booking is confirmed.

Early-morning climb to Budha Madhyamaheshwar for views of Chaukhamba, Kedarnath and Mandani peaks

Tempo Traveller from Delhi, 5 meals and a dedicated tour guide
overview:
Madhyamaheshwar, known as Dwitiya Kedar or the second abode of Shiva, is a temple reached by a 16 km trek from the village of Ransi. This **2 Nights / 3 Days** group departure starts from Delhi: the group meets at the pickup point for a short briefing and leaves by Tempo Traveller between 8 PM and 9 PM for the overnight journey to Ransi.

Day 1 is the drive via Rishikesh, with halts at Devprayag Sangam, Dhari Devi Temple and Omkareshwar Temple in Ukhimath, and a homestay night in Ransi. Day 2 is the trek to Madhyamaheshwar Temple: 6 km downhill to Goundhar and then a 10 km steep ascent, with the evening aarti and a homestay night near the temple. Day 3 starts with the 2 km climb to Budha Madhyamaheshwar, followed by the trek back to Ransi and the overnight drive to Delhi, arriving around 6-7 AM the next morning. Batches run from April to July. Prices start at ₹6,999 per person on quad sharing (5% GST extra).

itinerary.title: Departure from Delhi to Ransi (overnight journey)
itinerary.content:
Gather at the designated pickup point in Delhi.
Meet the team captain and attend a short orientation about the trip.
After the briefing, leave between 8 PM and 9 PM for the overnight journey to Ransi by Tempo Traveller.

itinerary.title: En route sightseeing | Arrival in Ransi
itinerary.content:
Reach Rishikesh in the morning and stop for breakfast.
Continue towards Ransi, with halts at Devprayag Sangam and Dhari Devi Temple.
Visit Omkareshwar Temple in Ukhimath, where the idols of Kedarnath Ji and Madhyamaheshwar Ji are kept after the temple gates close for winter.
After darshan, drive on to Ransi and check in to the homestay.
Dinner and overnight stay in Ransi.

itinerary.title: Trek to Madhyamaheshwar | Overnight stay near the temple
itinerary.content:
Trek distance: 16 km one way.
Start the trek at 5:00 AM after chai and bun.
The first 6 km are downhill to Goundhar (about 2 hours). Breakfast at Goundhar.
Continue with a 10 km steep ascent (7-8 hours) to Madhyamaheshwar Temple.
Reach by evening and check in to a local homestay near the temple.
Attend the evening aarti and take blessings at the temple.
Dinner and overnight stay at the homestay.

itinerary.title: Budha Madhyamaheshwar trek | Return to Ransi and depart for Delhi
itinerary.content:
Wake up at 4:00 AM and trek 2 km to Budha Madhyamaheshwar (a steep climb of about 1 hour).
Budha Madhyamaheshwar is known for its wide Himalayan views, including Chaukhamba, Kedarnath and Mandani peaks.
Return to the homestay near the temple for breakfast.
Trek down to Ransi (about 8 hours), with lunch at Goundhar on the way.
Freshen up in shared rooms at Ransi, then depart for Delhi.
Arrive in Delhi early the next morning (6-7 AM).

faqs.q: Where and when does the trip start?
faqs.a: The trip starts from Delhi. The group gathers at the pickup point for a short briefing and the overnight journey to Ransi by Tempo Traveller starts between 8 PM and 9 PM. The exact pickup point and time are shared once your booking is confirmed.

faqs.q: How much does the Madhyamaheshwar Trek cost?
faqs.a: ₹6,999 per person on quad sharing, ₹6,999 on triple sharing and ₹7,999 on double sharing. 5% GST is extra.

All transfers to and from Delhi in a Tempo Traveller, 2 nights of accommodation (1 night in Ransi and 1 night near Madhyamaheshwar Temple), 5 meals (2 breakfasts, 2 dinners and 1 lunch), a dedicated tour guide throughout and all sightseeing mentioned in the itinerary.

The trek from Ransi to Madhyamaheshwar Temple is 16 km one way: the first 6 km are downhill to Goundhar (about 2 hours), followed by a 10 km steep ascent of 7-8 hours. On Day 3 there is a 2 km steep climb of about 1 hour to Budha Madhyamaheshwar, and the trek back down to Ransi takes about 8 hours.

The first night is in a homestay in Ransi. The second night is in a basic local homestay near Madhyamaheshwar Temple, where rooms have 5-6 beds, so that night is on a sharing basis only, with separate rooms for men and women.

faqs.q: How do I book and pay?
faqs.a: Reserve your seat by paying 50% of the trip cost, and pay the rest at least 4 days before the trip. 5% GST is added to the price.

Cancel more than 10 days before the travel date and 50% of the advance is refunded; 5 to 10 days before, 25% of the advance; less than 5 days before, there is no refund. There is no refund for no-shows or early check-outs.

faqs.q: What do I need to carry?
faqs.a: A valid government-approved photo ID is a must: there is no boarding without it. Also pack comfortable clothes, sports or trekking shoes, a warm layer for the season, personal medicines and some cash. The full list is under Things To Pack.
